## Validation

## Safety implications

Relevant permissions, sensitive paths/content, data-loss risks, partial failures
and recovery limits, or explain why none apply. Use isolated fixtures for
destructive operations; omit private data from reports and screenshots.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] Targets `dev`; changes stay focused.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and acceptance criteria updated.
- [ ] Validation evidence and limitations recorded.
- [ ] No sensitive file paths, file contents or credentials included.
